The solute carrier family 6 member 1 gene encodes for the GABA transporter protein type 1
which is responsible for the reuptake of the neurotransmitter GABA, the primary inhibitory neurotransmitter in the central nervous system, from the extracellular space
the vast majority of which are likely to lead to GABA transporter protein type 1 loss-of-function
